reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis merely proposes standard calorimetric methods without any novel approach to address the known challenges of high-temperature measurements on reactive multi-component alloys, and the claimed <5% uncertainty is unsupported by physical rationale.
reasons.testability: The proposed falsification test is illogical because inconsistency with XRD or TEM (which do not directly measure fusion enthalpy or liquid properties) would not falsify the calorimetric accuracy claim.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis offers no new methodology, efficiency gain, or predictive framework beyond routine DSC/drop calorimetry, making it trivial and not useful for advancing the field.
